title: 孤儿院的冰糖葫芦
blurb_en: Two children promise to find each other when they are adopted on the same day. Twenty years later they bid against each other for the old orphanage.
blurb_zh: 两个孩子在同一天被不同的人家领走，说好了要找到对方。二十年以后，他们为了同一栋旧楼，成了对手。
